issues.text: Add a toCsv(rows) function in src/csv.js that turns the report rows into CSV with a header line.
Add a toJson(rows) function in src/json.js that returns the rows as pretty-printed JSON, with revenue added to each row.
Add a totals(rows) function in src/totals.js that returns total units and total revenue.
Add a byMonth(rows) function in src/months.js that groups the rows by the month of their date.
